datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Malawi administrative units on a quarterly schedule (January, April, July, October 2013). Geographic data was compiled into spatial datasets with classification scenarios and assistance requirements to support food security monitoring and humanitarian response planning.
